claims.claim_vi: Different countries have different payment frameworks, but in general the payment industry is composed of: regulatory authority, central bank, commercial banks, non-bank payment companies, payment systems, clearing networks, settlement systems.

design_notes_vi: Hai khung ghi chú (danh sách, không phải các bước): bảy phần theo đúng thứ tự của nguồn, rồi năm tài liệu. Bài này không vẽ mũi tên vì nguồn không nói bảy phần nối với nhau thế nào.
source_deviations: The source is a mind map image plus a list; the lesson keeps the list as the figure and adds a one-line explanation of each part in the text, marked as the author's general knowledge.
The source names "Payment Systems in the U.S. by GlenBrook"; the lesson writes it as the payment systems of the United States, by GlenBrook, without a link.
The lesson does not recreate the mind map, whose contents the source does not describe in text.
